Yesterday I ___ to the cinema.\nwent:
1) 'Yesterday' indica Simple Past.

She ___ her homework last night.\nfinish:
1) 'Last night' pede Simple Past.

What is the Simple Past of \"play\"?\npl:
1) Verbos regulares ganham -ed.

Resposta: played.
What is the Simple Past of \"have\"?\nha:
1) 'Have' é irregular.
2) have → had.

They ___ at home last Sunday.\nwere:
1) 'Last Sunday' indica passado.

I have ___ this film twice.\nseen:

He has ___ in London since 2020.\nlived:
1) 'Has' + particípio: has lived.
2) 'Since 2020' indica situação que continua.

She ___ here for five years.\nhas worked:
